arguments.where_clause: card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction made on a card whose type is prepaid debit, regardless of amount, channel or merchant.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit cards' is taken to mean card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'. Plain 'Debit' cards are not included.
